Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning transfers of clients between regional support networks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to strengthening families by allowing transfersbetween regional support networks to be closer to relatives or otherstrong personal supports; adding a new section to chapter 71.24 RCW;and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 1, 2013, the department shall propose rules andprocedures to govern transfers of clients between regional supportnetworks which allow the department to assume the authority to resolvedisputes that arise. The department shall work collaboratively withstakeholders, including representatives of consumers and families, indeveloping these rules and procedures, which when finalized, must beincorporated in regional support network contracts. (2) The department must submit a copy of the proposed rules andprocedures to the chairs of the relevant committees of the legislaturewhen the proposed rules and procedures are completed. p. 1 ESSB 5153 (3) This section expires June 30, 2015.
